rawEdits.new:
cleanup(llvm install)
# Record configured source/config before the actual build, not cleanup identity.
ExternalProject_Add_Step(llvm bilipai-capture-host-prebuild
    DEPENDEES configure
    DEPENDERS build
    COMMAND python3 ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packages/bilipai-host-llvm-source-snapshot.py
        capture-config --stage prebuild --build-dir <BINARY_DIR> --source-dir <SOURCE_DIR>
        --workspace ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/..
        --output ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bilipai-host-llvm-config
    LOG 1
    COMMENT "Capturing actual host LLVM source identity before build"
)
# Install must have used the exact prebuild source/config; preserve before cleanup.
ExternalProject_Add_Step(llvm bilipai-capture-host-config
    DEPENDEES install
    DEPENDERS postremovebuild
    COMMAND python3 ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/packages/bilipai-host-llvm-source-snapshot.py
        capture-config --stage postinstall --build-dir <BINARY_DIR> --source-dir <SOURCE_DIR>
        --workspace ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/..
        --output ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bilipai-host-llvm-config
    LOG 1
    COMMENT "Verifying actual installed host LLVM source/config before cleanup"
)
get_property(LLVM_SRC TARGET llvm PROPERTY _EP_SOURCE_DIR)
